assets.prompt:
Use case: compositing / ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished Russian Telegram story, portrait 9:16, 1080 x 1920, for ONE OF STUDIO, using the supplied authentic photograph of the office entrance of KomCity at Komsomolskaya 78 in Khabarovsk. Image 1 is the edit target / authentic building photo. Image 2 is the exact brand logo, white transparent logo to place on black.
Photo treatment: subtly improve exposure, natural contrast and clarity, make the actual street photo presentable but truthful. Keep exactly the real orange/yellow/coral facade, blue window bands, white door under the black curved canopy, long diagonal staircase, every railing and actual entry location. Keep the existing real signs unchanged and understated. Do not reconstruct the building, invent a new door, remove a structural element or turn this into glossy architecture illustration. Photo should be a wide rectangular inset across the middle, show the WHOLE source image including stair base and door; do not crop the entrance or staircase and do not expand the photo by inventing surroundings. A restrained red arrow overlay may follow the visible stairs from lower right toward the actual door under black canopy at upper left; exactly terminate at this door.
Design: crisp editorial navigation card on warm ivory #F5F2EC with black #111111 and restrained red #F12B2B accents, aligned spacious typography, large easy to read Russian text. Genuine source logo at top on small black panel. No decorative dance figures, no map, no bus stops, no invented hallway plan. Header and footer safe: keep essential text between y=150 and y=1700, horizontal margin at least 64px. Photo in middle approximately y=530 to1140. Below photo distinguish groups with big office numbers, ensure readability.

Hierarchy: address largest above photo; direction sentence near photo; 3rd-floor heading then two separate flat office rows below photo. Keep all text exact. No prices, schedules, CTA links or fake sign on the building. Export a SINGLE finished story not collage of variants.
